details:
Save data for the world "Fish!" fails to persist across world reloads despite the upload/saving packet screen completing normally.

Description:

When leaving the "Fish!" world instance, a popup screen appears indicating that packets are uploading alongside a button labeled "Discard save data." Even when allowing this process to complete fully without interruption, rejoining a new instance reveals that some or all progress has been lost and the save data did not load.

Conversely, relying entirely on the world's internal autosave mechanism requires remaining completely idle in the world for an unpredictable length of time (currently estimated around 10 minutes of socializing/waiting) to ensure progress is captured before leaving. Some users have reported that they still lose progress after waiting 10 minutes.

Because the developers of "Fish!" have confirmed that save data handling and persistence are managed entirely at the VRChat platform level rather than on their servers, this appears to be an issue with VRChat's Udon persistence or cloud save syncing mechanism failing to store or commit the player data correctly upon instance exit. Please see attached image.

Steps to Reproduce:

1. Join an instance of the world "Fish!".

2. Play the game and make progress that triggers save data.

3. Attempt to leave the instance and allow the VRChat upload/packet saving process to complete fully (without clicking "Discard save data").

4. Join a new instance of "Fish!".

5. Observe that the save data has not been retained.

Frequency:

Consistently / Frequently
title: VRChat Udon Persistence: Save data failing to persist despite successful upload/completion screen in "Fish!"
